TO THE MOST HIGH AND RENOWMED PRINCESSE, ELIZABETH, Queene of England, &c. A moſt gracious defender of the true Christian Faith.
TO THE MOST NOBLE AND RENOWMED, EDVVARD THE ſixth, King of England, &c. A true Chriſtian Prince.
THE FRENCH TRANSLATOR TO THE READER.
A PREFACE TO THE PROPHECIE OF ISAIAH:
An Epigram vpon the Tranſlation of M. Caluins Commentarie vpon the Prophecie of Iſaiah.
Oh that thou wouldeſt breake the heauens, and come downe:Maſter Caluin makes this, part of the 19. verſe. and that the mountanes might melt at thy preſence!
